visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair is seen from behind, walking through a brightly lit modern hallway with large glass walls. He is wearing a black bomber-style jacket with large white text 'NAKROTH' and a blue/black anime-style character graphic on the back. The indoor lighting is warm and bright, contrasting with the dark night visible through the glass. (2) He steps out onto a waterfront promenade at night. The background features a spectacular, densely lit city skyline across a body of water, recognizable as Hong Kong's Victoria Harbour. He walks towards the railing and spreads his arms wide in a welcoming or triumphant gesture, presenting the city view. (3) He turns around to face the camera, revealing he is wearing a black surgical-style face mask and a white t-shirt underneath his open jacket. He looks at the camera briefly before looking down and away. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing the vibrant neon lights of the skyscrapers and their reflections in the water behind him.
